title: Regime-Aware Multi-Asset Alpha Generation Under Transaction Costs and Multiple-Testing Correction
research_question: Does regime-aware multi-asset alpha generation improve out-of-sample risk-adjusted performance after transaction costs and multiple-testing correction?

hypotheses.null_hypothesis_H0: Regime awareness provides no statistically significant improvement in out-of-sample Sharpe ratio after transaction costs and multiple-testing correction.
hypotheses.alternative_hypothesis_H1: Regime-aware multi-asset alpha generation significantly improves out-of-sample risk-adjusted performance net of execution costs (DSR >= 0.95, FDR q <= 0.05).

universe_definition.equities_universe: S&P 500 Historical PIT Constituents (Top Liquidity Basket)

train_discovery.description: In-sample genetic search & feature exploration space

selection_validation.description: Walk-forward and purged CV model selection window

alpha_search_space.methodology: Genetic Programming AST Composition & Gradient Boosting SHAP Ranking

regime_models.model_r1: 3-State Gaussian Hidden Markov Model (Bull, Bear, Transition)

validation_protocol.cross_validation: Walk-Forward (12 Expanding Windows) and Purged K-Fold with 10-day Embargo

transaction_cost_model.market_impact_model: Almgren-Chriss Optimal Liquidation Trajectory (Square Root Volatility / ADV)
